text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a species distribution modeling study focused on the endangered hispid hare’s habitat suitability under current and future climate scenarios. While it incorporates land cover variables as covariates, its primary objective is ecological—predicting species habitat and conservation planning—not LULC prediction or simulation. It does not implement national-scale spatial LULC future predictions as a central research question, nor does it produce mapped LULC projections or quantitative LULC change metrics. The study scale is regional/transboundary species range, not an explicit national-scale LULC modeling. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria and meets exclusion criteria for species-specific ecological focus unrelated to LULC prediction.)
